A short, public summary appears below.

## Position

**University of Arkansas at Little Rock** — faculty in mathematics and
statistics; director of the Math Assistance Center.

## Research interests

- Bias-robust Bayesian meta-analysis (RoBMA, model-averaged Bayes
  factors, selection models).
- Publication bias and evidential fragility in applied literatures.
- Nutrition and health evidence synthesis.
- Reproducible statistical workflows (R, Quarto, Git, simulation).
- Statistics education, including Bayesian intuition at the introductory
  level and responsible use of AI tools.

See the [Research page](research.qmd) for current project descriptions.

## Teaching and service

- Undergraduate and graduate teaching in mathematics and statistics.
- Director of the Math Assistance Center (MAC) at UA Little Rock.
- Maintainer of public course sites for
  [Intro to Mathematical Software](/math-software/) and
  [Intro to Statistics](/intro-stats/).

See the [Teaching page](teaching.qmd) for current courses.
